name: Tamil Nadu Explorer Travels
description: Premier agency covering all of Tamil Nadu with expert guides, handcrafted itineraries, and 500+ happy travelers every year.

packages.name: Chennai Heritage & Coast Tour
packages.description: Explore Chennai's coastal wonders and ancient temples. Includes hotel stay, all transport, and meals.

packages.name: Kanchipuram Silk & Temples
packages.description: Day trip to the temple city of Kanchipuram. Shop for GI-certified Kanchipuram silk sarees after temple tours.

packages.name: Mahabalipuram Day Trip
packages.description: UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut temples along the Bay of Bengal. Expert heritage guide included.

name: Heritage South India Tours
description: Specialists in UNESCO-tagged Chola dynasty heritage sites. Guided by historians and archaeologists.

packages.name: Thanjavur Heritage 3-Day Circuit
packages.description: Dive deep into the Chola heartland. Includes Tanjore painting workshop, museum visits, and traditional Chettinad meals.

packages.name: Trichy & Srirangam Heritage
packages.description: Explore the temple-studded city of Trichy and the sacred Srirangam — one of the largest temple complexes in the world.

name: Coastal Tamil Travels
description: Curated coastal experiences along Tamil Nadu's 1000 km coastline — from Pulicat Lake to Kanyakumari.

packages.name: East Coast Highway Drive
packages.description: Drive along the scenic East Coast Road. Explore French quarters, fishing villages, and ancient temples by the sea.

packages.name: Rameswaram–Dhanushkodi Pilgrimage
packages.description: Walk where Lord Rama stood — cross the legendary Pamban Bridge and reach the tip of the Indian subcontinent.

name: Hill Station Escapes
description: Premium hill station getaways across Ooty, Kodaikanal, Yercaud, and the Western Ghats.

packages.name: Ooty Hill Escape 3 Days
packages.description: Ride the UNESCO Nilgiri Mountain Railway, explore tea estates, and enjoy the cool Nilgiri climate.

packages.name: Kodaikanal Nature Retreat
packages.description: Explore the Star Lake, misty viewpoints, and hidden waterfalls of the Princess of Hill Stations.

packages.name: Courtallam Waterfall Weekend
packages.description: Take a dip in the medicinal waterfalls of Courtallam. Rejuvenate in the Spa of South India.

name: Temple Trails TN
description: Dedicated pilgrimage and heritage tours across Tamil Nadu's most sacred temples with comfort-first logistics.

packages.name: Pancha Bhuta Stala Circuit
packages.description: Visit all five Pancha Bhuta Stalas — the temples representing the five elements in Hindu cosmology.

packages.name: Meenakshi Amman Madurai Special
packages.description: Early-morning darshan and full guided heritage walk through the city of Madurai.

name: Kanyakumari Sunrise Tours
description: Specialists in the tip-of-India experience — sunrise viewing, Vivekananda Rock, and coastal heritage.

packages.name: Kanyakumari Sunrise Special
packages.description: Wake up before dawn to witness the three-sea confluence sunrise — rated among India's most stunning spectacles.

name: Western Ghats Nature Trips
description: Off-beaten-path adventures in the Western Ghats, Anamalai Tiger Reserve, and Palni Hills.

packages.name: Anaimalai Jungle & Valley Tour
packages.description: Explore the biodiversity hotspot of Tamil Nadu's Western Ghats with jeep safaris and guided nature walks.

name: Kanchipuram Silk & Heritage
description: Customized tours combining Kanchipuram temple circuits with authentic handloom silk saree shopping experiences.

packages.name: Kanchipuram Full Day Heritage
packages.description: Temple darshan followed by a guided silk weaving demonstration and direct purchase from artisan cooperatives.
